notes.title: Attention: About floating buildings and totems and update preview
notes.notes:
We will update in 1 day，Here are some previews of this update. This is only for the players on the server. The stand-alone game model will not be affected, but it will have a certain impact on the buildings of the server players.
[olist]
 After the update, Totems can be destroyed in any mode. Change back to allow multiple people to interact with totem, so you need to place the totems in your own house and lock the door with a password lock to prevent others from destroying and interacting with your totems. The reason for this change is that a large number of totems in the PVE mode are arbitrarily built to occupy a large area of ​​land, causing the PVE server to be full, making it impossible for novice players to play the game. In the long run, the server will crash due to a large amount of data. It cannot be allowed to be built like this. The start point area will also be prohibited from construction. After the update, animals will also damage player buildings, so a circle of spiked walls must be built for defense.
 About floating buildings, The server will check the support every 10 minutes. Floating buildings without support on the server will automatically collapse. If you have such floating buildings on the server, Please recycle your items in the storage box of the floating building. , Note: This is a check function only for server buildings, stand-alone mode and personal servers are not affected
 
[/olist]
